summary_en: Iseki announced a share buyback program with a maximum of 330,000 shares (1.5% of outstanding shares) and 500 million yen (upper limit) through market purchases from November 16, 2026 to January 29, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while mitigating the impact of a concurrent equity offering.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 9, 2026, Iseki's Board of Directors approved a treasury stock acquisition program authorized under the Companies Act. The company will repurchase up to 330,000 shares, representing 1.5% of outstanding shares (22,632,676 shares excluding treasury stock), for an aggregate amount not exceeding 500 million yen. Purchases will be executed through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 16, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The company stated two primary objectives for the buyback. First, it aims to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency. Second, the repurchase program is designed to mitigate potential negative effects on share supply and demand arising from a concurrent equity offering announced on the same date. The board delegated implementation decisions, including the determination of purchase timing and price, to the representative director and president. The company noted that market conditions may prevent full execution of the authorized program.
